Hannah — thanks for the clear asks. A few product clarifications that change cost levers:

- Streaming generation defaults: moving to streaming-by-default reduces peak concurrency costs but increases token throughput. Need estimates from infra on net cost delta.
- Model variants: shipping a smaller quantized variant for summary tasks cuts token costs ~35% but requires one-off integration effort.
- Eval gating: adding tighter quality gates on rollouts increases time-to-deploy and slightly raises infra during canary windows.

Action: I'll put together a short appendix with estimated cost deltas and engineering effort by 09/07.

— Jonas Weber
VP, Product
Redwood Inference
